start: A member whose routines (Push, Pull, Legs) have no calf exercise; Muscle tips on; Workout tab, Up next card

steps.action: Look at the Up next card
user_sees: 'None of your routines trains your calves. Add 3 sets of Standing Calf Raise to your Legs routine?'
Buttons 'Add', 'Not now' and the link 'I skip this on purpose'
must_not: More than one tip at a time

user_sees: Sheet 'Why we suggest this': the routines counted ('We added up the sets planned in your ... routines'), sets a week per muscle, how a set counts
must_not: Logged workouts counted instead of the planned routines
A routine change before Add is tapped

user_sees: 'Adding…' then the tip goes away; Legs routine now has 3 sets of Standing Calf Raise
must_not: The same tip coming back on the next open

start: Routines that train shoulders 3 sets a week and chest 12 (tip 2, a swap)

user_sees: 'Your routines give your shoulders 3 sets a week and your chest 12. Add 3 sets of Dumbbell Shoulder Press to your Push routine, or swap Incline Dumbbell Press for it?'
Buttons 'Add', 'Swap', 'Not now' and the link 'Keep as is'
must_not: A swap tip for a gap like 6 against 10
A swap that leaves another group with no exercise

user_sees: 'Swapping…', then Incline Dumbbell Press replaced in the same place with the same sets
must_not: Both exercises left in the routine

steps.action: Open Settings, workout choices, Muscle tips
user_sees: Switch 'Muscle tips' with 'Now and then, Up next suggests one change when your routines leave out a muscle group or train one much less than the others'
must_not: The switch missing for a member who has seen a tip

start: Muscle tips switched off, or a balanced plan, or a beginner

steps.action: Switch 'Muscle tips' off, open the Workout tab
must_not: A tip while the switch is off

steps.action: With a plan that trains every group, open Up next
must_not: A 'below ideal' tip that is only taste

steps.action: As a beginner whose plan skips forearms only
user_sees: No tip (beginners see the big groups only)
must_not: A small-group tip to a beginner

steps.action: Tap 'Add' when the routine save fails
user_sees: A plain message that it could not be added; the tip stays
must_not: The tip gone though nothing was added

start: Up next shows the calves tip

user_sees: The tip goes away; it may come back after 4 weeks (spoken label 'Not now. Ask again in 4 weeks')
must_not: The tip back the next day

steps.action: After 4 weeks the tip comes back; tap 'Not now' again
user_sees: Spoken label 'Not now. Don't suggest it again'; the calves are muted
must_not: A third snooze instead of muting

steps.action: Open Settings, Muscle tips, tap 'Muscles you asked to skip' 'Bring back'
user_sees: The row lists 'your calves'; after 'Bring back' the row goes away
must_not: Muted groups still quiet after Bring back

steps.action: Tap 'I skip this on purpose' on a tip
user_sees: That group stays quiet for good and shows under 'Muscles you asked to skip'
must_not: The group back after an app update
